description: List the connected ad channels with their accounts: per channel the provider key, label, health (active, setup_required, error), the last sync time, any current sync error, campaign counts, and each account's id, name, currency, status and last sync. Also returns reportingCurrency, the workspace currency every revenue and ROAS figure is stated in. Read-only, from stored state: no ad platform is called, so a figure is as fresh as the last hourly sync. Takes no arguments. Use list_ad_campaigns with a provider for campaigns, spend and results, and list_ad_recommendations for what the CRM suggests.
name: list_ad_accounts
title: List ad accounts
